sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Cover art now gets the ⚠⟳ button the Relationships column got yesterday: ask again about only the entities the Cover Art Archive could not answer, instead of reloading every image in the table. The existing ⟳ button is unchanged and still reloads everything — right when you think what is on screen is stale, wrong as a way to recover three failed lookups out of two hundred. The button appears only when something has actually failed, and carries the count.

This needed a distinction the script could not previously make. A release the archive has no artwork for (a 404) and a release the archive could not answer about (a 503) both end up as "no artwork" on screen, and since the last release both were also remembered identically for the rest of the session. The transient ones are now marked as such — which is what the new button counts, and why a page full of releases that genuinely have no cover art shows no button at all rather than a large and useless number.
